sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本期节目最初发布在 Casefile 的 Patreon、Apple Premium 和 Spotify Premium 订阅源上，作为给付费订阅者的早期福利。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些节目的设计略短，使我们能够报道更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 您可以在您偏爱的平台上支持 Casefile，以便提前且无广告地收听这些节目。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: On Saturday May 5 1979, a shout rang out over the bustling Plaza Urbina Market Square in the Ecuadorian city of Ambato.
sentences.zh: 1979年5月5日星期六，厄瓜多尔安巴托市熙熙攘攘的乌尔比纳广场集市上响起了一声呐喊。

sentences.en: Alarming disappearance of Ecuadorian girls continues.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔女孩失踪事件令人堪忧，仍在持续。

sentences.en: The day's newspaper headline was met with dread from passing locals.
sentences.zh: 当天报纸的头条让路过的当地人感到恐惧。

sentences.en: For several months, girls between the ages of 7 and 14 had been vanishing from the streets of Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，年龄在7到14岁之间的女孩一直在厄瓜多尔的街道上不断失踪。

sentences.en: A majority of them worked as market vendors, having come from poor families who required them to sell goods to help make ends meet.
sentences.zh: 她们大多数人都是集市摊贩，来自贫困家庭，家里需要她们兜售货物来维持生计。

sentences.en: Because of this, the police mostly branded the girls as runaways.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，警方大多将这些失踪女孩定性为离家出走。

sentences.en: Some officers believed the girls had fled to bigger cities where they could get jobs as maids.
sentences.zh: 一些警官认为，这些女孩逃到了可以找到女佣工作的更大城市。

sentences.en: They told worried parents that their daughters were now probably better off.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉忧心忡忡的父母，他们的女儿现在可能过得更好。

sentences.en: Others suggested the girls had fled their homes out of shame for failing their school year.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为，女孩们是因为期末考试没及格感到羞耻而离家出走。

sentences.en: Despite being aware of the ever-increasing danger, many parents couldn't afford to hide their daughters away.
sentences.zh: 尽管意识到危险与日俱增，许多父母还是无力将女儿藏起来。

sentences.en: All they could do was keep a closer eye on their children and warn them not to go off with strangers.
sentences.zh: 他们能做的只有更加密切地关注孩子，并警告她们不要跟陌生人走。

sentences.en: It wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 这还远远不够。

sentences.en: Each week across the country, two to three girls continued to go missing.
sentences.zh: 全国各地每周都有两到三个女孩接连失踪。

sentences.en: At Plaza Robina, 11-year-old Hortensia Garces held a stack of the newspapers while shouting the horrifying headline, trying to catch the interest of passers-by.
sentences.zh: 在罗宾纳广场，11岁的霍滕西娅·加尔塞斯手里拿着一叠报纸，大声喊着骇人听闻的头条新闻，试图吸引过往行人的注意。

sentences.en: For Hortensia, selling newspapers was a necessity.
sentences.zh: 对于霍滕西娅来说，卖报纸是一项必需的工作。

sentences.en: She was about to become a big sister and had to help her family provide for the arrival of her brother.
sentences.zh: 她即将当上姐姐，必须帮家里为弟弟的降生筹备开销。

sentences.en: That evening, as darkness set in, Hortensia's family began to worry.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚，随着夜幕降临，霍滕西娅的家人开始担心起来。

sentences.en: Hortensia should have sold all of her newspapers hours ago, but she still hadn't returned home.
sentences.zh: 霍滕西娅本该在几个小时前就卖完所有的报纸，但她至今未归。

sentences.en: Fearing the worst, Hortensia's father ran to Plaza Robina.
sentences.zh: 霍滕西娅的父亲做好了最坏的打算，急忙跑向罗宾纳广场。

sentences.en: There was no sign of the 11-year-old anywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都找不到这个11岁女孩的踪影。

sentences.en: Three days later, the Tuesday edition of the newspaper was released.
sentences.zh: 三天后，星期二版本的报纸发行了。

sentences.en: The headline revealed that Hortensia Garces was the latest girl to go missing without a trace.
sentences.zh: 头条新闻披露，霍滕西娅·加尔塞斯是最新一个凭空失踪的女孩。

sentences.en: Over the next nine months, an increasing number of young Ecuadorian girls continued to go missing.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的九个月里，越来越多的厄瓜多尔年轻女孩接连失踪。

sentences.en: Investigators could no longer ignore the issue.
sentences.zh: 调查人员再也无法忽视这个问题了。

sentences.en: When they finally started looking into the string of disappearances, a distinct geographical pattern emerged.
sentences.zh: 当他们终于开始调查这一连串失踪案时，一个明显的地理规律浮现出来。

sentences.en: The towns and cities from where the girls had vanished were concentrated along the Andes mountain range.
sentences.zh: 女孩们失踪的城镇都集中在安第斯山脉沿线。

sentences.en: The northernmost town sat right up against the border with Colombia, while the southernmost town was near the border with Peru.
sentences.zh: 最北端的城镇紧邻哥伦比亚边境，而最南端的城镇则靠近秘鲁边境。

sentences.en: To police, this strongly suggested the involvement of human traffickers.
sentences.zh: 对警方来说，这强烈暗示有贩卖人口团伙的介入。

sentences.en: They theorised that the girls were being hidden in vehicles, funnelled along the Andes ranges and smuggled across the borders.
sentences.zh: 他们推测，这些女孩被藏在车里，沿着安第斯山脉运送并被走私过境。

sentences.en: The only city not positioned along the Andes was Guayaquil, which sat about 100 kilometres west of the mountains.
sentences.zh: 唯一一个不在安第斯山脉沿线的城市是瓜亚基尔，它位于山脉以西约100公里处。

sentences.en: What disturbed the police about this deviation was that Guayaquil was a port city.
sentences.zh: 令警方对这一异常情况感到不安的是，瓜亚基尔是一座港口城市。

sentences.en: It handled over 90% of the country's shipping container traffic.
sentences.zh: 它处理着该国90%以上的集装箱航运交通。

sentences.en: Police feared that the girls were being loaded into these containers and transported by sea.
sentences.zh: 警方担心女孩们被装进这些集装箱并通过海路运走。

sentences.en: Drug trafficking by Colombian gangs had been an increasing problem, and the theory quickly emerged that the criminals had expanded into child trafficking.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚帮派的贩毒活动日益严重，很快便出现了一种推测，即罪犯已经将业务扩展到了拐卖儿童领域。

sentences.en: National newspapers reported that the Colombians had recruited a network of on-the-ground members from within Ecuador to procure young girls from the streets.
sentences.zh: 全国各大报纸报道称，哥伦比亚人已在厄瓜多尔境内招募了一个实地成员网络，负责从街头物色年轻女孩。

sentences.en: They were most likely being transported to another country in South or Central America and sold into domestic or sexual slavery.
sentences.zh: 她们极有可能被运往南美或中美洲的其他国家，并被卖作家庭奴隶或性奴。

sentences.en: International child trafficking was a problem that had plagued South America for decades, but Ecuador had rarely seen it on such an enormous scale.
sentences.zh: 国际儿童贩运是困扰南美洲几十年的一个问题，但厄瓜多尔极少见到如此大规模的此类犯罪。

sentences.en: Citizens were on edge.
sentences.zh: 市民们都处于紧张不安的状态。

sentences.en: It was well known that members of trafficking organisations weren't limited to the obvious criminal types.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，贩运组织成员并不局限于那些一眼就能看出来的犯罪分子。

sentences.en: Anyone could be involved, from business owners to factory workers, local officials, and teachers.
sentences.zh: 任何人都有可能牵涉其中，从企业老板到工厂工人、地方官员以及教师。

sentences.en: The fact that the girls had been taken without anyone noticing suggested that the abductors could easily blend in with their communities.
sentences.zh: 女孩们在无人察觉的情况下被带走这一事实表明，绑架者可以轻而易举地融入他们的社区。

sentences.en: People became increasingly suspicious of their neighbours.
sentences.zh: 人们对邻居的戒心越来越重。

sentences.en: Across the country, police commenced a coordinated effort to capture anyone involved in the trafficking ring.
sentences.zh: 全国警方展开了一项协调行动，旨在抓捕所有卷入贩运网络的人。

sentences.en: Officers were posted at airports and bus terminals to identify any suspicious activity.
sentences.zh: 警员被派往机场和长途汽车站，以识别任何可疑活动。

sentences.en: Every truck, van, and car attempting to cross the border into Colombia or Peru was thoroughly searched.
sentences.zh: 每一辆试图穿过边境进入哥伦比亚或秘鲁的卡车、货车和小轿车都受到了彻底搜查。

sentences.en: Uniformed officers were stationed in marketplaces to provide a visible police presence, while undercover officers covertly patrolled these areas,
sentences.zh: 身穿制服的警官被部署在集市中以维持显眼的警察存在，而便衣警官则在这些区域秘密巡逻，

sentences.en: posing as market vendors or customers.
sentences.zh: 假扮成集市摊贩或顾客。

sentences.en: Around the clock surveillance teams watched the docks in Guayaquil, keeping an eye on all of the containers leaving Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 全天候监控小组监视着瓜亚基尔的码头，密切注视着离开厄瓜多尔的所有集装箱。

sentences.en: Undercover officers posed as dock workers in the hopes of gaining intel about human cargo.
sentences.zh: 便衣警官假扮成码头工人，希望能搜集到有关人体货物的谍报。

sentences.en: Despite these actions, not a single missing girl was located, nor a single suspect detained.
sentences.zh: 尽管采取了这些行动，但既没有找到哪怕一个失踪女孩，也没有拘留任何一名嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The fact that the police were being continuously outsmarted suggested that the trafficking ring was being run by highly skilled and highly organised criminals.
sentences.zh: 警方不断被智胜这一事实表明，这个贩运网络由技艺高超、组织严密的罪犯在幕后操纵。

sentences.en: By early 1980, 150 girls between the ages of 7 and 14 had been reported missing along the Andes Ranges.
sentences.zh: 到1980年初，安第斯山脉沿线已有150名年龄在7到14岁之间的女孩被报失踪。

sentences.en: As tensions heightened, the country's president demanded that the police produce results.
sentences.zh: 随着紧张局势加剧，该国总统要求警方拿出成果。

sentences.en: Ambato's police captain, Pastor Cordova, sat at his desk in contemplation.
sentences.zh: 安巴托警察局长帕斯特·科尔多瓦正坐在办公桌前沉思。

sentences.en: The disappearance of 11-year-old Hortensia Garces from Plaza Rubina nine months earlier wasn't the first in his jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 九个月前11岁女孩霍滕西娅·加尔塞斯在乌尔比纳广场失踪，并不是他辖区内的第一起。

sentences.en: Nearly a dozen girls had been stolen from Ambato on Captain Cordova's watch.
sentences.zh: 在科尔多瓦局长的眼皮底下，将近有十多名女孩在安巴托被绑走。

sentences.en: Frustrated and unsure what else to do,
sentences.zh: 感到沮丧且不知还能做些什么，

sentences.en: Captain Cordova began reviewing the rap sheets of Colombian criminals with known links to trafficking or other organised crime.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦局长开始翻阅那些与贩运或其他有组织犯罪有着已知联系的哥伦比亚罪犯的前科档案。

sentences.en: Perhaps his officers would get lucky and catch sight of one of these Colombians in Ambato.
sentences.zh: 也许他的警员们会走运，在安巴托瞥见这些哥伦比亚人中的某一个。

sentences.en: With the right interrogation tactics, they could use this one gang member to break open the entire trafficking operation.
sentences.zh: 只要运用正确的审讯策略，他们就能利用这名帮派成员来破获整个贩运行动。

sentences.en: The captain prayed to find one of these men before another girl went missing.
sentences.zh: 局长祈祷能在另一个女孩失踪之前找到这些人中的一个。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Thursday February 14, 1980, a well-respected bakery owner named Carlos Iacomé entered the Ambato police station and stood before Captain Cordova.
sentences.zh: 1980年2月14日星期四下午，一位备受尊敬的面包店老板名叫卡洛斯·雅科梅进入安巴托警察局，站在科尔多瓦局长面前。

sentences.en: Carlos was in obvious distress.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯显然心急如焚。

sentences.en: He explained that his nine-year-old daughter, Ivanova, sometimes brought food to him at the bakery's head office.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他9岁的女儿伊万诺娃有时会给面包店总部的他送食物。

sentences.en: She usually arrived by 11am, but on this day, she didn't turn up.
sentences.zh: 她通常在上午11点前到达，但今天她却没有出现。

sentences.en: Carlos went home to check that everything was okay, only to find that the house was empty.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯回家查看一切是否正常，结果却发现屋里空无一人。

sentences.en: He and his wife searched for Ivanova, but couldn't find her anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子四处寻找伊万诺娃，但到处都找不到她。

sentences.en: Captain Cordova considered what Carlos had just told him.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦局长斟酌着卡洛斯刚才对他说的话。

sentences.en: Ivanova Iacomé was within the preferred age range of the child traffickers, but she didn't fit with the rest of their usual victim profile.
sentences.zh: 伊万诺娃·雅科梅符合儿童拐卖者偏好的年龄范围，但她不符合他们通常的其他受害者画像。

sentences.en: Ivanova belonged to a wealthy family and didn't work as a market vendor.
sentences.zh: 伊万诺娃属于一个富裕家庭，并不从事集市小贩的工作。

sentences.en: Captain Cordova asked whether Ivanova's route would have taken her anywhere near Plaza Urbina.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦局长询问伊万诺娃的路线是否会经过乌尔比纳广场附近。

sentences.en: Carlos nodded.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯点了点头。

sentences.en: The Iacomé family home was right near the plaza.
sentences.zh: 雅科梅一家的住所就在广场附近。

sentences.en: Officers immediately began canvassing the streets between the Iacomé's home and the bakery's head office, asking if anyone had seen a young girl wearing blue overalls
sentences.zh: 警员们立即开始在雅科梅家和面包店总部之间的街道上进行挨家挨户的排查，询问是否有人见过一个身穿蓝色工装裤、

sentences.en: and a red apron with white polka dots.
sentences.zh: 系着带有白色波点红色围裙的小女孩。

sentences.en: Carlos and his wife pinned hundreds of missing person posters featuring a smiling picture of Ivanova to street lamps and shop windows across Ambato,
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯和他的妻子在安巴托各处的路灯杆和商店橱窗上贴了数百张寻人启事，上面印着伊万诺娃微笑着的照片，

sentences.en: offering a substantial cash reward for information.
sentences.zh: 并悬赏大量现金征集线索。

sentences.en: The investigation turned up nothing.
sentences.zh: 调查毫无结果。

sentences.en: Police couldn't even be certain where along the route Ivanova had been abducted.
sentences.zh: 警方甚至无法确定伊万诺娃是在这条路线的哪个具体地段被绑架的。

sentences.en: Three weeks after Ivanova's disappearance, on the morning of Sunday March 9, 1980,
sentences.zh: 在伊万诺娃失踪三周后的1980年3月9日星期天上午，

sentences.en: Plaza Urbina's market vendors huddled together before opening time.
sentences.zh: 乌尔比纳广场的集市摊贩们在开市前聚集在一起交头接耳。

sentences.en: Carlina Ramon, who ran the Hot Potato Stall and was the president of the Sellers Association, reminded the group that several young girls who worked in or near the plaza
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜·拉蒙经营着热土豆摊位，同时也是摊贩协会的主席，她提醒大家，几个在广场工作或附近的年轻女孩

sentences.en: had fallen victim to the child trafficking gang.
sentences.zh: 已经沦为了儿童拐卖帮派的受害者。

sentences.en: She urged everyone to be on the lookout for anything suspicious.
sentences.zh: 她敦促每个人都要留心任何可疑的情况。

sentences.en: Those in the crowd nodded in agreement before dispersing towards their stalls.
sentences.zh: 人群中发出赞同的点头声，随后各自散去走向自己的摊位。

sentences.en: Carlina called over her 11-year-old daughter, Maria, who would be manning a refreshment stand in the plaza that day.
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜把她11岁的女儿玛丽亚叫了过来，玛丽亚那天将在广场上负责看管一个茶水摊。

sentences.en: Carlina embraced Maria and implored her to be extra careful.
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜拥抱了玛丽亚，恳求她务必格外小心。

sentences.en: Maria skipped over to her stall and prepared for the day ahead.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚蹦蹦跳跳地回到她的摊位，为即将开始的一天做好准备。

sentences.en: Her friend Esther, not her real name, was also working at a refreshment stand nearby, and the two girls promised to look out for one another.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友埃丝特（化名）也在附近的一个茶水摊工作，两个女孩互相答应要照看好对方。

sentences.en: The crowd soon poured in, and by 10am, Plaza Urbina was buzzing with activity.
sentences.zh: 人群很快涌了进来，到上午10点，乌尔比纳广场已经人声鼎沸、热闹非凡。

sentences.en: Maria looked up as a tall, thin man with wavy brown hair and a toothless smile approached her stand.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚抬头看到一个身材高大、消瘦、留着棕色波浪卷发、笑起来没有牙齿的男人走近她的摊位。

sentences.en: He was carrying a jumbled collection of trinkets, including buttons, sewing kits, matches, chains, padlocks, suites, and cosmetics.
sentences.zh: 他拎着一堆杂七杂八的小玩意儿，包括纽扣、针线包、火柴、链条、挂锁、西装和化妆品。

sentences.en: The man pulled out a crumpled 100 Sucre bill and offered it to Maria.
sentences.zh: 那名男子掏出一张皱巴巴的100苏克雷纸币，递给玛丽亚。

sentences.en: It was a significant amount of money, and much more than any of the drinks coSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔可观的钱，远超任何饮料的成本。

sentences.en: Maria eyed the man suspiciously.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚带着戒备的眼神打量着这个男人。

sentences.en: He explained that he was a travelling street vendor who was only passing through town.
sentences.zh: 他解释说自己是一个路过该镇的流动街头小贩。

sentences.en: He needed help finding a bus that would take him to Guayaquil.
sentences.zh: 他需要帮忙找一辆能带他去瓜亚基尔的公共汽车。

sentences.en: The man offered to pay Maria the 100 Sucres if she took him to the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 男人提出如果玛丽亚带他去公交车站，就付给她100苏克雷。

sentences.en: Maria declined, telling the man she couldn't leave her stand.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚拒绝了，告诉男人她不能离开自己的摊位。

sentences.en: He turned and wandered away.
sentences.zh: 他转过身，溜达着走了开去。

sentences.en: Maria called to her friend Esther and explained the strange encounter.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚把她的朋友埃丝特叫过来，向她讲述了这段奇怪的遭遇。

sentences.en: They decided it was best to tell Maria's mother, Carlina, and dashed over to her store.
sentences.zh: 她们决定最好把这件事告诉玛丽亚的母亲卡莉娜，于是快步朝她的店铺跑去。

sentences.en: Carlina followed Maria back to the refreshment stand to see if the suspicious man was still loitering.
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜跟着玛丽亚回到茶水摊，看看那个可疑的男子是否还在附近游荡。

sentences.en: They scanned the surrounding faces, but he'd disappeared into the crowd.
sentences.zh: 她们仔细搜寻周围的面孔，但他已经消失在人群中了。

sentences.en: A few hours later, as the day's trade began to quieten down, the street vendor reappeared.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，随着一天的交易开始平静下来，那个街头小贩又出现了。

sentences.en: This time, he approached Esther's refreshment stand.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他走到了埃丝特的茶水摊前。

sentences.en: He repeated the story that he'd told Maria earlier, offering Esther the 100 Sucres to be his guide.
sentences.zh: 他重复了之前对玛丽亚说过的话，提出给埃丝特100苏克雷让她当向导。

sentences.en: He also offered to buy all of Esther's remaining drinks so that she wouldn't lose out on any money by leaving her stall unattended.
sentences.zh: 他还主动提出买下埃丝特所有剩下的饮料，这样她就不会因为离开摊位无人照看而损失金钱。

sentences.en: Esther was immediately mistrustful.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特立刻心生戒备。

sentences.en: She snapped back.
sentences.zh: 她没好气地顶了回去。

sentences.en: Without waiting for his response, Esther grabbed Maria and they hurried to find Carlina.
sentences.zh: 没等他回答，埃丝特就拉起玛丽亚急忙去找卡莉娜。

sentences.en: Carlina immediately sprung into action.
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜立即采取了行动。

sentences.en: She dashed over to where the girls had last seen the man, but he hadn't waited around.
sentences.zh: 她冲到女孩们最后看到那个男人的地方，但他并没有在原地等候。

sentences.en: Carlina quickly enlisted the help of other vendors and they spread themselves throughout the plaza on the hunt for the tall, toothless man carrying a collection of trinkets.
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜迅速招募了其他摊贩的帮忙，他们散布在广场的各个角落，搜寻那个携带着一堆小玩意的身材高大、没有牙齿的男人。

sentences.en: Carlina charged through the labyrinth of stalls until she was certain the whole market had been canvassed.
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜在错综复杂的摊位迷宫中穿行，直到确信整个集市都已被排查过。

sentences.en: Frustrated that he'd managed to escape again, Carlina stopped on the edge of the plaza to catch her breath.
sentences.zh: 由于懊恼对方再次成功逃脱，卡莉娜停在广场边缘喘口气。

sentences.en: Just as she was about to return to her potato stand, she spotted someone who fit the description of the man coming out of a butcher's shop across the street.
sentences.zh: 正当她准备返回土豆摊时，她瞥见街对面的一家肉铺里走出一个符合那名男子特征的人。

sentences.en: One of his abnormally large hands was wrapped around the tiny hand of a nine-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 他那只异常巨大的手正抓着一个9岁小女孩纤细的小手。

sentences.en: He was leading her away from the plaza.
sentences.zh: 他正领着她远离广场。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后继续。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持 Case File 继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Carlina began screaming that the man was kidnapping a child.
sentences.zh: 卡莉娜开始尖叫，大喊那个男人在绑架儿童。

sentences.en: She ran over to him and grabbed his arm.
sentences.zh: 她向他跑去并抓住了他的胳膊。

sentences.en: The man tried to wriggle out of Carlina's grasp, but she held onto him with all her strength, continuing to shout for assistance.
sentences.zh: 那名男子试图挣脱卡莉娜的抓握，但她使出全身力气死死抓住他不放，同时继续大声呼救。

sentences.en: Within seconds, nearly a dozen men pounced on the trinket vendor and held him securely.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，将近十多名男子猛扑向这个小贩，将他牢牢制伏。

sentences.en: Realising he couldn't escape, the man stopped struggling.
sentences.zh: 意识到自己无法逃脱，那名男子停止了挣扎。

sentences.en: He offered the crowd a toothless smile, saying he was just a simple travelling street vendor trying to make a living.
sentences.zh: 他冲着人群咧嘴露出一个没牙的微笑，说他只是一个试图混口饭吃的普通流动街头小贩。

sentences.en: He claimed that the young girl was merely showing him the way to the bus station so he could continue his journey.
sentences.zh: 他声称这个小女孩只是在给他带路去公交车站，以便他能继续他的旅程。

sentences.en: To some of the men, this explanation seemed entirely plausible.
sentences.zh: 在某些男人看来，这个解释显得完全合情合理。

sentences.en: Thinking they may have reacted unfairly, they relaxed their grip.
sentences.zh: 他们以为自己可能反应过激了，于是放松了手上的力道。

sentences.en: But Carlina didn't believe a word of it.
sentences.zh: 但卡莉娜一个字也不信。

sentences.en: She told the crowd that the trinket seller was part of the trafficking ring abducting and selling young girls.
sentences.zh: 她告诉人群，这个小贩是拐卖和出售年轻女孩的贩运网络的一员。

sentences.en: He'd earlier tried to lure her own daughter away with money.
sentences.zh: 他刚才还试图用金钱诱拐她自己的女儿。

sentences.en: Those in front could see that the confused nine-year-old girl from the butcher's shop was grasping a crumpled 100 Sucre bill.
sentences.zh: 站在前面的人可以看到，肉铺里那个神情迷茫的9岁小女孩正紧紧抓着一张皱巴巴的100苏克雷纸币。

sentences.en: The crowd was torn.
sentences.zh: 人群意见不一。

sentences.en: Some supported Carlina, while others thought she was being hysterical.
sentences.zh: 有些人支持卡莉娜，而另一些人则认为她是在歇斯底里。

sentences.en: As calls to let the man go began to circulate, police arrived on the scene and took him into custody.
sentences.zh: 正当放过这个男人的呼声开始传开时，警察赶到了现场并将其拘留。

sentences.en: When Ambato's police captain, Pastor Córdova, entered the interrogation room, he was furious.
sentences.zh: 当安巴托的警察队长帕斯特尔·科尔多瓦走进审讯室时，他雷霆大怒。

sentences.en: The detaining officers had tried to extract information from the trinket vendor with violence and he sat bruised and bloody.
sentences.zh: 拘留警员曾试图用暴力从小饰品小贩那里逼出口供，此时小贩身上青一块紫一块，血迹斑斑。

sentences.en: The beatings hadn't achieved anything.
sentences.zh: 殴打毫无成效。

sentences.en: The man insisted he was innocent and knew nothing about the alleged trafficking ring.
sentences.zh: 这名男子坚称自己是无辜的，对所谓的贩运集团一无所知。

sentences.en: Captain Córdova feared that the officers had squandered any chance to get information from the suspect.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长担心警员们已经葬送了从嫌疑人身上获取信息的任何机会。

sentences.en: Instead, he decided to approach with kindness.
sentences.zh: 相反，他决定以温和的方式接近对方。

sentences.en: Captain Córdova brought the man a drink and a sandwich and offered him a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长给男子拿来了一杯饮料和一个三明治，还递上一支烟。

sentences.en: The two sat smoking together in silence.
sentences.zh: 两人坐在一起默默地抽着烟。

sentences.en: Eventually, Captain Córdova assured the trinket vendor that he wouldn't receive any more beatings and asked if the two could just talk for a while.
sentences.zh: 最终，科尔多瓦队长向小饰品小贩保证他不会再挨打，并询问两人是否能聊一会儿。

sentences.en: The man nodded in agreement.
sentences.zh: 男子点头表示同意。

sentences.en: He said his name was Pedro Alonso López and he was a 31-year-old travelling vendor from Colombia.
sentences.zh: 他说自己叫佩德罗·阿隆索·洛佩斯，是一名来自哥伦比亚的31岁流动小贩。

sentences.en: The captain maintained a calm exterior, but internally he was excited, thinking he may have finally caught one of the Colombian gang members.
sentences.zh: 队长表面上保持镇定，内心却兴奋不已，心想自己可能终于抓住了哥伦比亚帮派成员之一。

sentences.en: Córdova leaned in a little further and said,
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦再往前凑了凑，说道：

sentences.en: Tell me about yourself.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你自己的事吧。

sentences.en: López relaxed and started to talk.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯放松下来，开始讲了起来。

sentences.en: Captain Córdova desperately wanted to ask about the missing girls, but he didn't want to jump into the subject too soon.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长迫切想问问失踪女孩的事，但他不想太快切入这个主题。

sentences.en: Instead, he asked López whether he had a criminal paSt.
sentences.zh: 相反，他问洛佩斯是否有过犯罪前科。

sentences.en: López admitted that when he was 21 he was caught stealing a car in Borgata, the capital city of Colombia.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯承认，21岁时他在哥伦比亚首都博尔加塔因偷车被抓。

sentences.en: He was sent to prison for seven years.
sentences.zh: 他被判入狱七年。

sentences.en: One night, four older men entered his cell and raped him.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，四个年长的囚犯闯进他的牢房强暴了他。

sentences.en: López swore revenge.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯发誓要报复。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, he lured each of the men, one by one, back into his cell.
sentences.zh: 两周后，他把这四个人一个接一个地诱骗回自己的牢房。

sentences.en: He stabbed three of them to death with a makeshift knife.
sentences.zh: 他用自制刀具刺死其中三人。

sentences.en: The fourth managed to escape and raised the alarm.
sentences.zh: 第四个人设法逃脱并拉响了警报。

sentences.en: The authorities considered the killings to be in self-defence and López wasn't harshly punished.
sentences.zh: 当局认为这些谋杀属于正当防卫，洛佩斯没有受到严惩。

sentences.en: Since his release, López made his meagre living as a travelling street vendor.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，洛佩斯靠当流动街头小贩维持着微薄的生计。

sentences.en: He told Captain Córdova that he liked to be continuously on the move between Colombia, Ecuador and Peru.
sentences.zh: 他告诉科尔多瓦队长，他喜欢不断地在哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁之间四处奔波。

sentences.en: Recognising this as an opportunity, the captain suggested to López that a man who travelled so much must have seen many things.
sentences.zh: 队长意识到这是一个机会，便向洛佩斯暗示，一个经常旅行的人一定见过很多东西。

sentences.en: López agreed.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯表示赞同。

sentences.en: Captain Córdova pushed.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长进一步逼问。

sentences.en: So, you must know about the traffickers of the little girls.
sentences.zh: 所以，你一定知道那些小女孩的贩子喽。

sentences.en: López shook his head.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯摇了摇头。

sentences.en: He said he didn't know anything about traffickers and wasn't involved with that sort of thing at all.
sentences.zh: 他说自己对人贩子一无所知，也根本不涉足那种事情。

sentences.en: López then gave the captain a broad, toothless smile and said,
sentences.zh: 接着，洛佩斯冲队长咧嘴一笑，露出了没牙的笑容，说道：

sentences.en: But, I do know about the girls.
sentences.zh: 不过，我确实知道那些女孩的事。

sentences.en: López said the police should forget about chasing down a child trafficking ring.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯说警察应该放弃追查儿童贩卖集团。

sentences.en: He said there was only one person responsible for the missing girls.
sentences.zh: 他说对失踪女孩负有责任的只有一个人。

sentences.en: And that person was him.
sentences.zh: 那个人就是他。

sentences.en: Captain Córdova was unconvinced.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长并不相信。

sentences.en: Over 150 girls had been reported missing over the past year and it wasn't possible that one man had kidnapped them all.
sentences.zh: 过去一年里有超过150名女孩被报失踪，一个人不可能把她们全绑架了。

sentences.en: Furthermore, if Pedro López really was responsible, selling the girls would have earned him a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果佩德罗·洛佩斯真的是罪魁祸首，贩卖这些女孩会让他赚大钱。

sentences.en: The man sitting before him was near penniless.
sentences.zh: 可坐在他面前的这个男人几乎身无分文。

sentences.en: Regardless, the captain did believe López knew something about what had happened to the missing girls.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，队长确实相信洛佩斯知道失踪女孩遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: He asked,
sentences.zh: 他问道：

sentences.en: Where are the girls now?
sentences.zh: 女孩们现在在哪里？

sentences.en: López laughed and spoke triumphantly.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯大笑起来，得意洋洋地说道：

sentences.en: They are all dead.
sentences.zh: 她们都死了。

sentences.en: Dead and buried along the Andes.
sentences.zh: 死后被埋在了安第斯山脉沿线。

sentences.en: He flashed another toothless grin and continued,
sentences.zh: 他又露出了没牙的笑容，继续说道：

sentences.en: I'll show you.
sentences.zh: 我带你们去。

sentences.en: Within the hour, Captain Córdova and two other officers were in a police car following López's directions.
sentences.zh: 不到一个小时，科尔多瓦队长和另外两名警员就坐上一辆警车，按照洛佩斯的指引前进。

sentences.en: They drove north out of Ambato for about 16km until they reached a rural farming area.
sentences.zh: 他们向北驶出安巴托约16公里，来到一个乡村农耕区。

sentences.en: López directed the police through a number of turns down nondescripted dirt roads until he finally signalled for the car to stop.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯指引警察在平淡无奇的泥土路上左拐右弯，直到最后示意停车。

sentences.en: Córdova and his officers followed López on foot through scrub until they came to a gap in a fence.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦和警员们步行穿过灌木丛跟随洛佩斯，直到来到栅栏的一个缺口处。

sentences.en: López slipped through and ran ahead.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯钻了过去，跑到前面。

sentences.en: When the officers caught up, López was standing in front of a small wooden box.
sentences.zh: 当警员们追上去时，洛佩斯正站在一个木制小箱子前。

sentences.en: It was roughly 130cm long and 90cm wide and looked like it was intended to be a makeshift beehive.
sentences.zh: 它大约长130厘米、宽90厘米，看起来像是用来当自制蜂箱的。

sentences.en: A stanch hung in the air as López pointed to the box.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯指向箱子时，空气中弥漫着一股恶臭。

sentences.en: The officers used crowbars to crack open the lid.
sentences.zh: 警员们用撬棍撬开了盖子。

sentences.en: Inside was a dirty mattress.
sentences.zh: 里面是一个脏兮兮的床垫。

sentences.en: On top of the mattress was the naked body of a young girl.
sentences.zh: 床垫上面躺着一个小女孩赤裸的尸体。

sentences.en: Captain Córdova immediately knew who she was.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长一眼就认出了她是谁。

sentences.en: Tucked alongside her body was a pair of blue overalls and a red apron with white polka dots.
sentences.zh: 紧挨着她尸体放着的是一件蓝色工装裤和一件带有白色波点印花的红围裙。

sentences.en: It was nine-year-old Ivanova Yakome.
sentences.zh: 死者是9岁的伊万诺娃·亚科梅。

sentences.en: Investigators had assumed that Ivanova had been abducted while walking to deliver food to her father.
sentences.zh: 调查人员曾推测伊万诺娃是在给父亲送饭的路上被劫持的。

sentences.en: But according to López, that wasn't the case.
sentences.zh: 但根据洛佩斯的说法，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: He explained that on the morning of Thursday, February 14, 1980, he was passing by the Yakome's house when Ivanova poked her head outside the front door.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，在1980年2月14日星期四的早晨，他路过亚科梅家时，伊万诺娃把头探出前门。

sentences.en: She looked up the street before retreating back inside.
sentences.zh: 她朝街上望了望，然后又缩回了屋里。

sentences.en: López stopped in his tracks.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯停下脚步。

sentences.en: He watched the house for a few hours until he was certain that the child was home alone.
sentences.zh: 他在房子外面监视了几个小时，直到确信这孩子独自在家。

sentences.en: López eventually knocked on the front door, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯最终敲了前门，但无人应答。

sentences.en: He called out to Ivanova, saying he was a friend of her father's.
sentences.zh: 他朝伊万诺娃喊话，自称是她父亲的朋友。

sentences.en: Ivanova cautiously opened the door.
sentences.zh: 伊万诺娃小心翼翼地打开了门。

sentences.en: López produced ten sucrées and said that Ivanova's parents wanted them to go to the store to buy vegetables.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯掏出十苏克雷，说伊万诺娃的父母让他们去商店买蔬菜。

sentences.en: Ivanova was hesitant, but López said that her parents would be angry if she didn't go with him.
sentences.zh: 伊万诺娃有些犹豫，但洛佩斯说如果她不跟他一起去，父母会生气的。

sentences.en: She took López's hand and the pair walked down the street.
sentences.zh: 她拉住洛佩斯的手，两人顺着街道走去。

sentences.en: López spoke to Ivanova sweetly and distracted her with conversation.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯温柔地对伊万诺娃说话，用聊天分散她的注意力。

sentences.en: He guided her out of Ambato and towards the rural countryside.
sentences.zh: 他将她带出安巴托，朝着乡村郊外走去。

sentences.en: After several hours, they were amongst farmlands.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，他们置身于农田之中。

sentences.en: By nightfall, Ivanova became tired of walking and started asking for her mother.
sentences.zh: 夜幕降临时，伊万诺娃走路走累了，开始吵着要找妈妈。

sentences.en: López looked around and spotted the wooden box plus a discarded mattress lying nearby.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯环顾四周，发现了那个木箱以及附近丢弃的一个旧床垫。

sentences.en: He opened the box and placed the mattress inside.
sentences.zh: 他打开箱子，把床垫放了进去。

sentences.en: All of his friendliness towards Ivanova disappeared and he ordered her to climb inside.
sentences.zh: 他对伊万诺娃的所有友好态度荡然无存，命令她爬进箱子。

sentences.en: López subdued Ivanova by punching her twice in the head.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯对着她的头部打两拳，将伊万诺娃制服。

sentences.en: He then raped her repeatedly before strangling her to death.
sentences.zh: 随后他多次对她实施性侵，并将其勒死。

sentences.en: López slept alongside her body for a while before closing the lid of the box and walking away.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯在她的尸体旁躺着睡了一会儿，然后合上箱盖扬长而去。

sentences.en: Captain Pastor Córdova made the heartbreaking call to Ivanova's parents.
sentences.zh: 帕斯特尔·科尔多瓦队长怀着心碎的心情给伊万诺娃的父母打了电话。

sentences.en: When Carlos Iacomé saw his daughter's body, he was unable to speak.
sentences.zh: 当卡洛斯·亚科梅看到女儿的遗体时，他泣不成声、说不出话来。

sentences.en: Ivanova's mother collapsed to the floor.
sentences.zh: 伊万诺娃的母亲瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: An autopsy on Ivanova's body later corroborated López's account of his attack.
sentences.zh: 随后对伊万诺娃尸体的尸检证实了洛佩斯关于他袭击过程的供述。

sentences.en: López had more to say.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯还有话要说。

sentences.en: He was eager to take police to another of his young victiMs.
sentences.zh: 他急切地想带警察去见他的另一个年轻受害者。

sentences.en: As they prepared to depart the station, they were met by an angry mob baying for López's blood.
sentences.zh: 当他们准备离开警局时，迎面遇上一群愤怒的暴民，叫嚷着要取洛佩斯的性命。

sentences.en: Captain Córdova tried to appease the crowd, telling them he understood their anger, but this wasn't just about Ivanova.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长试图安抚人群，告诉他们他理解大家的愤怒，但这不只是关于伊万诺娃的事。

sentences.en: There were many more missing girls to be found.
sentences.zh: 还有更多失踪女孩等待被找到。

sentences.en: The crowd ignored the captain's pleas to be patient and repeatedly called for López to be lynched.
sentences.zh: 人群无视队长保持耐心的恳求，反复高呼要对洛佩斯实施私刑。

sentences.en: Officers were forced to smuggle López through an alternative exit and bundle him into a waiting police vehicle.
sentences.zh: 警员们被迫把洛佩斯从另一条出口偷偷带走，并把他塞进一辆等候着的警车里。

sentences.en: This time, they didn't have to travel far.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他们不用走多远。

sentences.en: Pedro López directed police to the outskirts of town, where the Ficoa Bridge connected central Ambató with the affluent neighbourhood of Ficoa.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·洛佩斯引导警察来到镇郊，菲科阿大桥在那里将安巴托市中心与富裕的菲科阿社区连接起来。

sentences.en: He specified a site underneath the bridge on the banks of the Ambató River.
sentences.zh: 他指明了安巴托河畔桥下的一个地点。

sentences.en: Officers began digging, and it wasn't long before they found something buried underneath.
sentences.zh: 警员们开始挖掘，没过多久就在下面挖出了埋着的东西。

sentences.en: It was a stack of newspapers, dated May 5, 1979, the day that 11-year-old Hortensia Garces had disappeared.
sentences.zh: 那是一叠报纸，日期是1979年5月5日，即11岁女孩霍滕西亚·加尔塞斯失踪的那天。

sentences.en: Underneath the papers was a small set of skeletal remains.
sentences.zh: 报纸下面是一副小型骨骼遗骸。

sentences.en: News that a second body had been uncovered quickly spread and hundreds of townsfolk had gathered on the scene.
sentences.zh: 发现第二具尸体的消息迅速传开，数百名镇民聚集到现场。

sentences.en: As the remains were lifted out of the dirt, Captain Cordova spotted Hortensia's parents in the crowd and brought them forward.
sentences.zh: 当遗骸从泥土中被抬出来时，科尔多瓦队长在人群中发现了霍滕西亚的父母，并把他们带了过来。

sentences.en: The body was too badly decomposed to be identified, but Hortensia's parents recognised her clothes.
sentences.zh: 尸体腐烂得太严重无法辨认，但霍滕西亚的父母认出了她的衣服。

sentences.en: The angry crowd began throwing rocks at López, forcing police to remove him from the scene.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的人群开始向洛佩斯扔石头，迫使警察将他撤离现场。

sentences.en: On their way back to the station, López confessed that he'd approached Hortensia Garces as she was crossing the Ficoa Bridge.
sentences.zh: 在返回警局的路上，洛佩斯供认，当霍滕西亚·加尔塞斯穿过菲科阿大桥时，他接近了她。

sentences.en: He took a copy of the newspaper and made a comment about the missing girls' headline.
sentences.zh: 他拿了一份报纸，对失踪女孩的头条新闻发表了评论。

sentences.en: He then asked Hortensia to be his guide, offering to pay 10 sucres as well as buy all of her remaining papers.
sentences.zh: 接着他请霍滕西亚当他的向导，主动提出支付10苏克雷，并买下她手里所有剩下的报纸。

sentences.en: López led Hortensia into the thick vegetation of the riverbank where he proceeded to repeatedly rape her before strangling her to death.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯将霍滕西亚引到河岸茂密的植被中，随后对她实施了多次强奸并将其勒死。

sentences.en: He rested alongside Hortensia's corpse for a few hours, then buried her and her newspapers in a nearby ditch.
sentences.zh: 他在霍滕西亚的尸体旁休息了几个小时，然后将她和她的报纸埋在附近的一个沟渠里。

sentences.en: López then went in search of another little girl.
sentences.zh: 接着洛佩斯去寻找另一个小女孩。

sentences.en: He couldn't find one that day, but he told police that he got lucky the next.
sentences.zh: 那天他没找到，但他告诉警察第二天他走运了。

sentences.en: Over the following weeks, Pedro López led Captain Cordova and his officers to 110 remote and obscure locations across Ecuador
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，佩德罗·洛佩斯带着科尔多瓦队长和警员们来到厄瓜多尔110个偏远隐蔽的地点

sentences.en: where he claimed to have buried the bodies of his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己将受害者的尸体埋在了那里。

sentences.en: None of the sites were marked, yet López recalled each location with precision.
sentences.zh: 这些地点都没有做记号，但洛佩斯对每个地点的记忆都极其精准。

sentences.en: At some sites, multiple bodies had been callously thrown on top of one another.
sentences.zh: 在某些地点，多具尸体被冷酷地叠压抛弃在一起。

sentences.en: At others, no bodies could be found, the remains presumably destroyed by animals, weather, and time.
sentences.zh: 而在另一些地点，则找不到任何尸体，遗骸想必已经被动物、天气和时间毁坏了。

sentences.en: Construction work had since been conducted at several locations, entombing any remains under concrete.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，几个地点已经进行了建筑施工，将任何遗骸封埋在水泥之下。

sentences.en: Every time a body was discovered, López explained how the girl came to be there.
sentences.zh: 每当发现一具尸体，洛佩斯就会解释这个女孩是如何被弄到那里的。

sentences.en: The story was more or less always the same.
sentences.zh: 故事的内容大同小异。

sentences.en: López would befriend his young victim and then lead her to a secluded location before raping and killing her.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯会与他年轻的受害者交朋友，然后把她带到偏僻的地方实施强奸并杀害。

sentences.en: Eventually, López told Captain Cordova,
sentences.zh: 最终，洛佩斯对科尔多瓦队长说：

sentences.en: No more, I have proven enough that I am the one responsible for all the girls.
sentences.zh: 够了，我已经充分证明了我就是对所有女孩负有责任的那个人。

sentences.en: In all, the bodies of 80 Ecuadorian girls were uncovered.
sentences.zh: 总共出土了80名厄瓜多尔女孩的尸体。

sentences.en: But, by López's own admissions, police believed he was responsible for over 100 murders in the country.
sentences.zh: 但根据洛佩斯自己的供认，警方相信他在国内造成了100多起谋杀案。

sentences.en: The people of Ecuador weren't suffering alone.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔人民并不是唯一在痛苦中煎熬的人。

sentences.en: López had happily admitted that he'd done the same in Colombia and Peru.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯已经高兴地承认他在哥伦比亚和秘鲁也干过同样的事。

sentences.en: Across the three countries, he claimed to have taken at least 300 lives.
sentences.zh: 他声称在这三个国家里，自己夺走了至少300条生命。

sentences.en: The realisation dawned on Captain Cordova.
sentences.zh: 科尔多瓦队长猛然意识到这一点。

sentences.en: Pedro López was one of the most prolific serial killers ever known.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·洛佩斯是有史以来作案最多的连环杀手之一。

sentences.en: While in custody awaiting trial, Pedro López was permitted to participate in media interviews.
sentences.zh: 在等待审判的羁押期间，佩德罗·洛佩斯被允许接受媒体采访。

sentences.en: He delighted in the attention and took pleasure in detailing his story to anyone who would listen.
sentences.zh: 他沉浸在关注中，并且乐于向任何愿意倾听的人详述他的故事。

sentences.en: Explaining how he chose his victims, he said,
sentences.zh: 在解释他是如何挑选受害者时，他说：

sentences.en: I would walk among the markets looking for a girl with a certain look on her face, a look of innocence and beauty.
sentences.zh: 我会在集市里闲逛，寻找一个脸上带着某种神情的女孩，一种天真而美丽的表情。

sentences.en: I like the girls of Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢厄瓜多尔的女孩。

sentences.en: They are more gentle, more innocent and trusting than the girls of Colombia, who are too suspicious of strangers.
sentences.zh: 她们比哥伦比亚的女孩更温柔、更天真、更轻信他人，哥伦比亚的女孩对陌生人防备心太重。

sentences.en: López admitted that the girls he targeted were victims of convenience.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯承认，他盯上的女孩都是顺手抓来的受害者。

sentences.en: He had often followed fair-haired children of tourists, but his opportunity to strike never arose, as, quote,
sentences.zh: 他经常尾随游客的金发小孩，但一直找不到下手的好机会，因为，引述原话：

sentences.en: Their parents were too watchful.
sentences.zh: 她们的父母看管得太严了。

sentences.en: According to López, it all started in the mid-1970s following his release from prison.
sentences.zh: 据洛佩斯所说，这一切都始于20世纪70年代中期他出狱之后。

sentences.en: He spent a lot of time wandering through the mountains near the picturesque Tecundama Falls, about 30 kilometres south-west of Bogota.
sentences.zh: 他花了很多时间在风景如画的特昆达马瀑布附近的群山中流连，该瀑布位于波哥大西南约30公里处。

sentences.en: During one journey, he came across a young girl walking down a dirt road.
sentences.zh: 在一次行程中，他遇到一个沿着泥土路走的小女孩。

sentences.en: She became López's first child victim, and the Tecundama Falls area became a burial ground for a number of young girls thereafter.
sentences.zh: 她成了洛佩斯的第一个儿童受害者，此后特昆达马瀑布地区成了多名年轻女孩的埋骨之地。

sentences.en: López eventually made his way down to Peru, where the rapes and murders continued.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯最终南下秘鲁，强奸和谋杀在那里继续发生。

sentences.en: In 1978, López was travelling through a small village in the Ayacucho region of southern Peru.
sentences.zh: 1978年，洛佩斯正穿行于秘鲁南部阿亚库乔地区的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: He managed to convince a nine-year-old indigenous girl to accompany him for a walk,
sentences.zh: 他设法说服了一个9岁的土著女孩陪他散步，

sentences.en: but several villagers saw what he was doing and quickly realised that López was responsible for the spate of missing girls in the area.
sentences.zh: 但有几个村民看到了他的举动，很快意识到洛佩斯就是当地一连串失踪女孩案的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: The community decided they would punish López according to their native custoMs.
sentences.zh: 社区决定按照他们的本土习俗惩罚洛佩斯。

sentences.en: He was stripped naked and hog-tied.
sentences.zh: 他被扒光衣服，五花大绑。

sentences.en: Honey was poured all over his body and he was thrown into a large hole.
sentences.zh: 他全身被浇满蜂蜜，然后被扔进了一个大坑里。

sentences.en: The villagers were planning to first torture López with live ants and then bury him alive.
sentences.zh: 村民们原本打算先用活蚂蚁折磨洛佩斯，然后再把他活埋。

sentences.en: Just as they were about to release the ants, an American woman stepped forward.
sentences.zh: 就在他们准备放蚂蚁的时候，一个美国女人走了出来。

sentences.en: She was a Christian missionary who had been promoting her faith in the village.
sentences.zh: 她是一名基督教传教士，一直在村里传播她的信仰。

sentences.en: The woman begged the villagers not to go through with their plan.
sentences.zh: 这个女人恳求村民们不要执行他们的计划。

sentences.en: She urged them to let her deliver López to the Peruvian authorities instead.
sentences.zh: 她劝说他们把洛佩斯交由秘鲁当局处理。

sentences.en: The villagers agreed.
sentences.zh: 村民们同意了。

sentences.en: López was hauled into the woman's jeep and driven to the region's police station.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯被拉进女人的吉普车，并被带到了当地的警察局。

sentences.en: But the Peruvian police were apathetic to the plight of indigenous communities and they had no interest in investigating López's involvement with the missing girls.
sentences.zh: 但秘鲁警察对土著社区的困境无动于衷，他们对调查洛佩斯与失踪女孩的牵连毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: Without so much as questioning him, they escorted López across the border and released him back into Colombia.
sentences.zh: 甚至连审问都没有，他们就护送洛佩斯过境，将他释放回了哥伦比亚。

sentences.en: López estimated that by the time he left Peru in 1978, he had murdered over 100 girls there.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯估计，到1978年他离开秘鲁时，他在那里已经谋杀了一百多名女孩。

sentences.en: He claimed to have spent the next year travelling along the Andes mountain range between Colombia and Ecuador, abducting, raping and strangling young girls with impunity.
sentences.zh: 他声称第二年一直在哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔之间的安第斯山脉旅行，逍遥法外地绑架、强奸并勒死年轻女孩。

sentences.en: Based on the number of burial locations that Pedro López had pinpointed to Ecuadorian police, he was eventually charged with the rape and murder of 110 girls.
sentences.zh: 根据佩德罗·洛佩斯向厄瓜多尔警方指认的埋尸地点数量，他最终被指控强奸并谋杀110名女孩。

sentences.en: In July 1981, 14 months after his capture, López faced the judge.
sentences.zh: 1981年7月，在他被捕14个月后，洛佩斯出庭受审。

sentences.en: Despite his previous confessions, and for reasons unknown, he pleaded guilty to only 57 of those charges.
sentences.zh: 尽管他之前有过供认，但出于未知原因，他对其中57项指控认罪。

sentences.en: López labelled himself the man of the century, while the people of Ecuador called him the monster of the Andes.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯自称是世纪伟人，而厄瓜多尔人民则称他为安第斯山脉的怪物。

sentences.en: The general consensus was that López deserved nothing short of execution, but the death penalty had been abolished in Ecuador 70 years prior.
sentences.zh: 普遍的共识是，洛佩斯罪大恶极理应处死，但厄瓜多尔在70年前就已经废除了死刑。

sentences.en: The revulsion against López's crimes was so great that a mass protest was staged in Ambato.
sentences.zh: 人们对洛佩斯罪行的愤怒是如此之大，以至于安巴托爆发了大规模抗议活动。

sentences.en: The families of the young victims petitioned the president to allow the death penalty in this instance, commenting,
sentences.zh: 年轻受害者的家属向总统请愿，要求在这种情况下允许死刑，他们评论道：

sentences.en: Our hearts are bloodied and our hands are raised to heaven imploring justice.
sentences.zh: 我们心如刀绞，双手高举向苍天祈求正义。

sentences.en: The president acknowledged the pain that the families and all Ecuadorians were feeling, but rejected the requeSt.
sentences.zh: 总统承认了家属和所有厄瓜多尔人民感到的痛苦，但拒绝了请求。

sentences.en: Instead, he asked them to put their trust in the justice system, assuring that López would be punished to the full extent of the law.
sentences.zh: 相反，他要求他们相信司法系统，并保证洛佩斯将受到法律制裁的严惩。

sentences.en: Ecuador's criminal code did not permit sentences for murder to run consecutively.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔的刑法不允许谋杀刑期合并执行。

sentences.en: Accordingly, Pedro López would only be sentenced for one murder, not the dozens he had pleaded guilty to, nor the potential hundreds he was responsible for.
sentences.zh: 因此，佩德罗·洛佩斯只会因为一桩谋杀案被判刑，而不是他认罪的几十起，也不是他应负责任的潜在数百起。

sentences.en: López was given the maximum penalty for murder that was in force in Ecuador at the time.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯被判处了当时厄瓜多尔现行法律规定的最高谋杀刑罚。

sentences.en: 16 years.
Just over 13 years later, on Wednesday, August 31, 1994,
sentences.zh: 仅仅13年多后，即1994年8月31日星期三，

sentences.en: Pedro López was released from prison early on account of good behaviour.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·洛佩斯因表现良好而提前出狱。

sentences.en: He was 45 years old.
sentences.zh: 他当时45岁。

sentences.en: However, López was considered an illegal immigrant in Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 然而，洛佩斯在厄瓜多尔被视为非法移民。

sentences.en: As soon as he was released, he was immediately taken into custody by immigration officials.
sentences.zh: 他刚一出狱，就被移民官员立即拘留。

sentences.en: The following day, he was escorted across the border and delivered to the Colombian authorities.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他被押送过境，并被移交给哥伦比亚当局。

sentences.en: It was the moment they'd been waiting for for 14 years.
sentences.zh: 这是他们等待了14年的时刻。

sentences.en: In late December 1979, two months prior to López's capture in Ecuador, a nine-year-old girl named Flora Sanchez went missing from the Colombian town of El Espanol.
sentences.zh: 1979年12月下旬，即洛佩斯在厄瓜多尔被捕两个月前，一个名叫弗洛拉·桑切斯的九岁女孩在哥伦比亚的埃尔埃斯帕尼奥尔镇失踪。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Flora's body was discovered.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，弗洛拉的尸体被发现。

sentences.en: She had been raped and strangled.
sentences.zh: 她曾遭到强奸和勒颈。

sentences.en: Over the following weeks, the bodies of four more girls were discovered in Andean towns leading south and back towards Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，又有四名女孩的尸体在向南通往并返回厄瓜多尔的安第斯城镇中被发现。

sentences.en: At the time, Colombian authorities had no idea who was responsible for the murders.
sentences.zh: 当时，哥伦比亚当局根本不知道谁是这些谋杀案的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: After Pedro López was captured in Ecuador, the reality became clear.
sentences.zh: 在佩德罗·洛佩斯于厄瓜多尔被捕后，真相大白。

sentences.en: El Espanol was López's hometown.
sentences.zh: 埃尔埃斯帕尼奥尔是洛佩斯的家乡。

sentences.en: Flora Sanchez had gone missing the day after Pedro López arrived for a visit there.
sentences.zh: 弗洛拉·桑切斯在佩德罗·洛佩斯到那里访问的第二天失踪了。

sentences.en: He left town a few days later, travelling his usual route south along the Andes.
sentences.zh: 几天后他离开小镇，沿著他惯常的安第斯山脉南下路线前行。

sentences.en: In media interviews following his capture, López boasted about committing many murders in El Espanol.
sentences.zh: 在他被捕后接受的媒体采访中，洛佩斯吹嘘自己在埃尔埃斯帕尼奥尔犯下了许多谋杀案。

sentences.en: He was amused that the police hadn't found more bodies.
sentences.zh: 他对警察没有发现更多尸体感到好笑。

sentences.en: With Pedro López back on Colombian soil, authorities were finally able to charge him with the murder of Flora Sanchez.
sentences.zh: 随著佩德罗·洛佩斯回到哥伦比亚领土，当局终于能够以谋杀弗洛拉·桑切斯的罪名起诉他。

sentences.en: In Colombia, the maximum penalty for murder was 60 years.
sentences.zh: 在哥伦比亚，谋杀的最高刑罚是60年。

sentences.en: Given López was 45, 60 years would effectively be a life sentence.
sentences.zh: 鉴于洛佩斯45岁，60年实际上就是无期徒刑。

sentences.en: This gave comfort to the families of López's victims, who felt cheated by the leniency of Ecuador's justice system.
sentences.zh: 这给洛佩斯受害者的家属带来了一些安慰，他们曾对厄瓜多尔司法系统的宽大处理感到受骗。

sentences.en: But such comfort was short-lived.
sentences.zh: 但这种安慰并未持续多久。

sentences.en: As part of the pretrial procedures, López was subjected to a psychiatric examination.
sentences.zh: 作为审判前程序的一部分，洛佩斯接受了精神病学检查。

sentences.en: He was deemed mentally ill and therefore not criminally responsible for his actions.
sentences.zh: 他被判定患有精神疾病，因此对自己的行为不承担刑事责任。

sentences.en: López had consistently described a childhood of abuse and trauma.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯一直描述自己有一个充满虐待和创伤的童年。

sentences.en: He claimed that his mother was a sex worker, that he never knew his own father, and that all of his siblings were fathered by different men.
sentences.zh: 他声称他的母亲是一名性工作者，他从未见过自己的亲生父亲，他的所有兄弟姐妹都是由不同的父亲所生。

sentences.en: As a child, López claimed that his mother was violent and abusive towards him, kicking him out of the family home when he was just 8 years old.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯声称，作为一名儿童，他的母亲对他是暴力相向且虐待的，在他年仅8岁时就把他赶出了家门。

sentences.en: He spent the rest of his childhood on the streets.
sentences.zh: 他的余下童年都在街头度过。

sentences.en: López recalled he'd once been taken in by a seemingly kind man, who turned out to be a pedophile.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯回忆说，他曾被一个看似善良的男人收留，但后来发现那是个恋童癖者。

sentences.en: He escaped and returned to the streets.
sentences.zh: 他逃跑了，又回到了街上。

sentences.en: A few years later, when López was 12, an American couple took pity on him.
sentences.zh: 几年后，当洛佩斯12岁时，一对美国夫妇怜悯了他。

sentences.en: They gave him food and clothes and enrolled him in school.
sentences.zh: 他们给了他食物和衣服，并送他去上学。

sentences.en: There, López claimed he was sexually abused by one of the teachers.
sentences.zh: 在那里，洛佩斯声称自己遭到了一名老师的性虐待。

sentences.en: According to López, the rapes and murders he committed were in retaliation for his own childhood.
sentences.zh: 据洛佩斯所说，他犯下的强奸和谋杀案是对自己童年的报复。

sentences.en: He told the media,
sentences.zh: 他告诉媒体：

sentences.en: After López's psychological assessment was handed down in Colombia, the psychiatric community debated his mental state.
sentences.zh: 在哥伦比亚公布了洛佩斯的心理评估结果后，精神病学界对他的精神状态展开了争论。

sentences.en: Some believed that López was turned into a rapist and killer by his childhood experiences.
sentences.zh: 一些人认为洛佩斯是因为童年经历才变成了强奸犯和杀人犯。

sentences.en: Others believed he was a born psychopath, incapable of remorse or rehabilitation.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为他是天生的精神病态者，没有悔意，也无法接受矫治。

sentences.en: Instead of a life behind bars, he was sent to a mental health facility for ongoing treatment.
sentences.zh: 他没有被关进监狱，而是被送往精神健康机构接受持续治疗。

sentences.en: Just over three years later, in February 1998, Pedro López was declared cured and sane.
sentences.zh: 仅仅三年多后，即1998年2月，佩德罗·洛佩斯被宣布治愈且精神正常。

sentences.en: At the age of 49 years, he walked out of the facility a free man.
sentences.zh: 49岁那年，他走出了机构，成了一个自由人。

sentences.en: The first thing López did was travel to El Espanol to see his mother, Benilda.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯做的第一件事就是前往埃尔埃斯帕尼奥尔看望他的母亲贝尼尔达。

sentences.en: In the years since López had been captured, Benilda had been interviewed several times.
sentences.zh: 在洛佩斯被捕后的几年里，贝尼尔达曾多次接受采访。

sentences.en: She rejected her son's claims of child abuse, saying that although their family was poor and life wasn't easy, theirs had always been a loving home.
sentences.zh: 她否认了儿子关于虐待儿童的说法，称尽管他们的家庭很穷，生活也不容易，但他们的家一直是一个充满爱的家。

sentences.en: Benilda claimed she made her living as a laundress, not a sex worker.
sentences.zh: 贝尼尔达声称她是以洗衣妇为生，而不是性工作者。

sentences.en: She clarified that López's father had died six months before López was born, having been killed during Colombia's civil violence.
sentences.zh: 她澄清说，洛佩斯的父亲在洛佩斯出生前六个月去世了，在哥伦比亚的内战暴力中丧生。

sentences.en: According to Benilda, López grew angry and resentful after she remarried and had children with her new husband.
sentences.zh: 据贝尼尔达所说，在她再婚并与新丈夫生了孩子后，洛佩斯变得愤怒和怨恨。

sentences.en: He wasn't kicked out of home, but had left on his own accord.
sentences.zh: 他并不是被赶出家门的，而是自己主动离开的。

sentences.en: He returned at the age of 18, at which point Benilda caught him inappropriately touching his younger sisters and kicked him out.
sentences.zh: 他在18岁时回来了，当时贝尼尔达发现他对年幼的妹妹们有不当抚摸行为，便把他赶了出去。

sentences.en: Benilda said her son was a disgrace to society.
sentences.zh: 贝尼尔达说她的儿子是社会的耻辱。

sentences.en: If she had known what he was capable of, she said she would have killed him herself to save humanity from his crimes.
sentences.zh: 她说，如果她早知道他能做出这种事，她会亲手杀了他，以免人类遭受他罪行的祸害。

sentences.en: She expressed her deep apologies to the families of his victims, whom she lit a candle for every day.
sentences.zh: 她对受害者的家属表达了深深的歉意，并每天为他们点蜡烛。

sentences.en: Benilda had no desire to see her son again.
sentences.zh: 贝尼尔达根本不想再见到她的儿子。

sentences.en: When López arrived at her door after being released from the mental health facility, it wasn't for a family reunion.
sentences.zh: 当洛佩斯从精神健康机构释放后出现在她门前时，并不是为了什么家庭团聚。

sentences.en: He wanted money.
sentences.zh: 他是来要钱的。

sentences.en: Benilda was still very poor and had nothing to give.
sentences.zh: 贝尼尔达依然非常穷，没什么可给的。

sentences.en: Instead, López took some of her furniture and sold it for a meagre amount of cash.
sentences.zh: 于是，洛佩斯拿走了她的一些家具，并以微薄的现金将其卖掉。

sentences.en: He left El Espinel and faded back into the Andes.
sentences.zh: 他离开了埃尔埃斯帕尼奥尔，重新消失在安第斯山脉中。

sentences.en: In the years that followed, other young girls between the ages of 7 and 14 went missing along the mountain range.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，其他年龄在7岁到14岁之间的年轻女孩在这条山脉沿线失踪。

sentences.en: Of those who were found deceased, some had suffered the same fate as Pedro López's previous victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在那些被发现已经死亡的人中，有些人遭遇了与佩德罗·洛佩斯以前的受害者相同的命运。

sentences.en: He immediately became a suspect.
sentences.zh: 他立即成为了嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Not only did the crimes fit his M.O., there were serious doubts that he could ever be rehabilitated.
sentences.zh: 这些犯罪手法不仅符合他的作案特点，人们也严重怀疑他是否能够被改造成好人。

sentences.en: López had been proud of his crimes and at no point had he ever shown a hint of remorse.
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯一直为自己的罪行感到骄傲，并且在任何时候都没有表现出一丝悔意。

sentences.en: López had once told the Ecuadorian police, quote,
sentences.zh: 洛佩斯曾对厄瓜多尔警方说，原话是：

sentences.en: The moment of death is passionate and exciting.
sentences.zh: 死亡的时刻是充满激情和刺激的。

sentences.en: Someday, when I'm free, I'll feel that moment again.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，当我自由了，我会再次感受到那个时刻。

sentences.en: I will be happy to kill again.
sentences.zh: 我将很高兴再次杀戮。

sentences.en: It is my mission.
sentences.zh: 这是我的使命。

sentences.en: In 2002, Interpol issued a warrant for Pedro López's arrest, but he couldn't be located.
sentences.zh: 2002年，国际刑警组织对佩德罗·洛佩斯发出了逮捕令，但他下落不明。

sentences.en: Family members of his victims had been vocal about their desire for revenge.
sentences.zh: 受害者的家属一直直言不讳地表达他们复仇的渴望。

sentences.en: Some had threatened to shoot López, others to burn him alive.
sentences.zh: 一些人威胁要枪杀洛佩斯，另一些人则威胁要将他活活烧死。

sentences.en: The mother of one young victim had told reporters,
sentences.zh: 一名年轻受害者的母亲曾告诉记者：

sentences.en: I wanted to break him into pieces because he killed my baby.
sentences.zh: 我想把他碎尸万段，因为他杀了我心爱的宝贝。

sentences.en: Carlina Ramón, the market vendor who captured López near Plaza Robina, supported the intention, stating,
sentences.zh: 在罗宾娜广场附近抓获洛佩斯的市场小贩卡丽娜·拉蒙支持这种意图，她表示：

sentences.en: It would be a kindness to the world for someone to murder this fiend.
sentences.zh: 如果有人能谋杀这个恶魔，那是对世界的一种善举。

sentences.en: Many believe that someone did just that.
sentences.zh: 许多人相信，确实有人这么做了。

sentences.en: As of mid-2023, Pedro López has never been found alive.
sentences.zh: 截至2023年中期，人们从未发现佩德罗·洛佩斯还活着。

sentences.en: If he is still alive, López would be in his mid-70s.
sentences.zh: 如果他还活着，洛佩斯现在应该七十多岁了。

sentences.en: Back in 1980, when Pedro López led Ecuadorian police to his burial sites, the remains of his victims were transported to the Ambató police headquarters.
sentences.zh: 早在1980年，当佩德罗·洛佩斯带领厄瓜多尔警方前往他的埋尸地点时，受害者的遗骸被运到了安巴托警察局。

sentences.en: Parents of missing girls travelled from across the country to view one corpse after another.
sentences.zh: 失踪女孩的父母从全国各地赶来，一具接一具地查看尸体。

sentences.en: For many, a visual identification wasn't possible.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，目视辨认是不可能的。

sentences.en: Instead, grief-stricken mothers and fathers clutched familiar items of clothing and wept over bones.
sentences.zh: 相反，悲痛欲绝的母亲和父亲紧紧抓着熟悉的衣物，对着白骨痛哭。

sentences.en: Some mothers screamed and passed out, while anguished fathers punched walls.
sentences.zh: 一些母亲尖叫着昏厥过去，而痛苦的父亲则拳打墙壁。

sentences.en: Captain Pastor Córdova would never forget watching the heartbreaking procession of grieving parents.
sentences.zh: 帕斯托·科尔多瓦上尉永远不会忘记看到这支令人心碎的悲痛父母队伍的情景。

sentences.en: Years later, he described it as,
sentences.zh: 多年后，他将其描述为：

sentences.en: The most painful thing I've ever seen in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子见过最痛苦的事情。

sentences.en: Nearly half of the victims uncovered by police could not be identified.
sentences.zh: 警方发掘的受害者中，近一半无法辨认身份。

sentences.en: If López's confessions are to be relied on, potentially hundreds more in Colombia and Peru remain lost and buried.
sentences.zh: 如果洛佩斯的供词可信，在哥伦比亚和秘鲁可能还有数百名失踪人员下落不明且被埋葬。

sentences.en: The true number and identities of the missing girls of the Andes will likely never be known.
sentences.zh: 安第斯山脉失踪女孩的真实人数和身份可能永远不会为人所知。
